groups.activity: open relics, sell Prime parts for Ducats

rows.label: fast fissures, take the Prime part
rows.note: Exterminate and Capture; one player reported over 1,000 Ducats in an hour

rows.label: Credits
rows.note: Chroma with a credit booster, Profit-Taker or Index runs

conditions: Ducats come only from trading Prime parts and blueprints at a Ducat Kiosk in a Relay.
Baro's stock is random, so spending Ducats on his other items can leave you short when the Zylok appears. Keep 500 Ducats and 200,000 credits in reserve.
bonuses: Upgrade relics to Radiant with Void Traces first; an area-damage frame like Ember or Equinox keeps fissures quick.

disclosures.title: why not endless fissures
disclosures.body: Several players call endless Defense and Survival slower per relic than short Exterminate and Capture runs.

groups.activity: check Baro's rotating stock, then buy if listed

live.text: check the Ducat Kiosk countdown for his next relay

rows.label: Zylok
rows.note: built; 200,000 credits + 500 Ducats, only when in his rotating stock

conditions: There is no blueprint or build time. The Zylok Incarnon Genesis is a separate upgrade and does not give you the weapon.

disclosures.title: how often it returns
disclosures.body: One tracker says it has come back about three times a year, three to four months apart. A rough pattern, not a promise.

disclosures.title: trading for it
disclosures.body: A Zylok can be traded only unranked with no Forma or Catalyst installed, and the receiver must be Mastery Rank 6 or higher. The Pyrus Project event that first handed it out is over.
